text: acct-5d1e2d (mirage): one question before I change the Pinnacle order: which is 'the pinnacle feed' you want first? In the engine today the 'Pinnacle feed' IS PinnWire/pinnapi (the keyed hosts, 12 PinnWire keys + 3 PinnAPI keys), so there is nothing ahead of it. Do you mean (a) PinnAPI's keys first and PinnWire as backup, (b) the Pinnodds socket/REST (needs the key in a secret, which the repo rule forbids unless you say so in a session), or (c) another feed I should read as the Pinnacle price (BoltOdds/ParlayAPI) first? Tell me a/b/c and I'll make the change and release it.
